A polypeptide consisting of 58 amino acids that inhibits the activity of several proteolytic enzymes such as chymotrypsin, kallikrein (kallidinogenase), plasmin (fibrinolysin), and trypsin. It contains not less than 3 Ph. Eur. units/mg calculated with reference to the dried sub- stance. An almost white, hygroscopic powder. Soluble in water and in isotonic solutions; practically insoluble in organic sol- vents. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Aprotinin Concentrated Solution).
